items.title: Fuel gas tie-in reroute (no combustor shutdown)

events.text: MPLX SOW Rev 3 §3.1: the flare fuel (pilot) gas tie-in was scoped with a short 2–3 hour shut-in of pilot gas to existing Combustor FL-12020. That shut-in is the basis that has now changed.
Joel Schweers scheduled a "Piping on Hold" meeting (later canceled). Tegre identified an alternate tie-in location on the fuel gas header.

Joel notified West Tech: Operations will not allow a shutdown of the existing combustor, so the fuel gas piping is changing. Red-lined IFC ISOs issued; affected spools are not to be fabricated. New ISOs, revised BOM and updated P&IDs to follow.
I met with the project team on the fuel gas tie-in and rack routing, then walked the route down with West Tech.

I reviewed the hold markups (JRS Rev 0, 11/23/26): "Piping on Hold" DWG. 1 and red-lined IFC ISOs. On hold: 1"-FG-12010-151, 1"-FG-12010-151S, 1"-FG-12012-151, 2"-FG-12013-151S, 2"-FG-12120-151 sheet 3 of 3, and EXIST 2"-FG-13003-151 tie-in. 8"-FL-12100-151S (6 sheets) and 2"-FG-12120-151 sheets 1–2 not marked.

open: West Tech to list any affected spools fabricated or partly fabricated before the hold.
Hold markup DWG. 2 (referenced on most red-lined ISOs) — not received.
Updated ISOs, revised BOM and P&IDs from Tegre/MPLX — not yet received.
West Tech to price added or changed work; written MPLX authorization before it proceeds.
